lines: A module is delivered more than once inside a single page:
app-DvS-j2Og: 753 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 753 B.
admin-BhIpoPhG: 753 B beyond the first copy, generated by vite 753 B.
All 2 pages load the same 8 files: 2,596,768 B raw, 581,204 B gzip, 99.7 % of the smallest page (admin-BhIpoPhG, 2,603,339 B).
Files: js/emoji-mart-vue-fast-tSW2SXzH.mjs 1,008,309 B, js/nextcloud-dialogs-CvFQUNZU.mjs 876,843 B, js/nextcloud-vue-BQlE-JtO.mjs 348,174 B, js/nextcloud-common-CTvGHat0.mjs 245,357 B, and 4 more.
Inside: @vue/runtime-dom 854,146 B, @nextcloud/vue 530,333 B, @nextcloud/dialogs 315,094 B, @vuepic/vue-datepicker 137,214 B, webdav 128,357 B.
1 delivered file carries no source map, so their bytes are charged only where the code shows its origin by itself: the glue of the bundler, code of the bundler and its plugins.
36 B in 1 piece of 1 file have no owner: no mapping covers them, and the code matches no file of a neighbouring module, of the app, or of the bundler and its plugins.
No package is imported as a whole: every package contributes only the modules that are used (54 packages, 562 modules).
On this measure the form of importing is exhausted. A root import whose barrel the bundler removes completely leaves no trace, so this is evidence, not proof.
No bundler chunk in dist is left without something that loads it.
